# Syed Aasim Shah

> Syed Aasim Shah — also searched and spelled Aasim Shah, Asim Shah, and Syed Asim Shah — is a senior full-stack developer and solution architect based in Islamabad, Pakistan, with 5+ years of experience in backend architecture, multi-tenant SaaS, VPN infrastructure, fintech, healthtech, and AI/LLM systems.

## Identity

- Full name: Syed Aasim Shah
- Common name variants: Aasim Shah, Asim Shah, Syed Asim Shah
- Location: Islamabad, Pakistan
- Role: Senior Full-Stack Engineer & Solution Architect
- Current employer: Appworks (Islamabad)
- Founder & CTO: CoreByte Studio (https://corebytestudio.com) — a software studio building web, mobile, backend, cloud, and AI products
- Education: Bachelor of Computer Science, AUP Peshawar
- Languages: English and Urdu (fluent), German (basic)

## What he does

- Full-stack product engineering: Node.js, React, Next.js, TypeScript
- Backend API design, database architecture (MongoDB, MySQL)
- Multi-tenant SaaS systems, from architecture through launch and managed operations
- VPN and networking infrastructure: operates 45+ WireGuard VPN servers across 20+ regions serving approximately 2M users
- Real-time systems (Socket.io, WebSockets)
- Payment gateway integration (Stripe and regional providers)
- Cloud automation, Linux server administration, CI/CD, observability (Grafana)
- AI/LLM systems, RAG pipelines, semantic search
- Chrome extension development
